target.title: fix(config/sessions): narrow reply-session initialization revision to identity fields
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #98672. Users observed `reply session initialization conflicted for agent:main:main` errors that broke ongoing sessions until the gateway was restarted. The error came from the guarded reply-session initialization path comparing the full persisted session entry between snapshot and commit.

## Why This Change Was Made

The initialization guard only needs to detect whether another initializer rotated the session (i.e. changed `sessionId`/`sessionFile`). Comparing the entire entry included volatile fields such as `updatedAt`, `lastHeartbeatSentAt`, pending-delivery metadata, etc. These are legitimately mutated by background heartbeat runners, delivery retries, and other gateway activity, so unrelated metadata changes produced false-positive `stale-snapshot` conflicts.

The guard is narrowed to the identity fields `sessionId` and `sessionFile`. When that identity-only guard passes, the commit path now carries forward only metadata that **changed since the snapshot** (`mergeConcurrentReplySessionMetadata`). Fields the prepared turn entry explicitly modified relative to the snapshot still win, so `/new` and `/reset` continue to clear recovered auto-fallback provider/model overrides, runtime model caches, and context-budget state as before.

## User Impact

- Sessions no longer fail with `reply session initialization conflicted` when background activity touches session metadata.
- Real session rotations are still detected and retried as before.
- Concurrent heartbeat/delivery/context metadata written after the snapshot is no longer overwritten by the initialization commit.
- Explicit reset clearing behavior (`/new`, `/reset`) is preserved.

## Evidence

- Updated regression test `commits reply session initialization despite non-identity metadata changes` in `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.test.ts` now asserts that `lastHeartbeatSentAt` and `lastHeartbeatText` survive the accepted commit.
- `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.test.ts`: 60/60 tests pass.
- `src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts`: 124/124 tests pass, including the reset override clearing tests.
- `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-session-lifecycle.test.ts` + `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-session-reset.test.ts`: 17/17 tests pass.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` passes.
- `pnpm tsgo:core:test` and `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` pass (this also fixes the `check-test-types` failure caused by the original test using string values for the typed `contextBudgetStatus` field).
- `oxfmt --check` and `oxlint` pass on changed files.

### Terminal proof: focused regression tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.runtime-config.config.ts src/config/sessions/session-accessor.test.ts -t "commits reply session initialization despite non-identity metadata changes" --reporter=verbose

 ✓ |runtime-config| src/config/sessions/session-accessor.test.ts > session accessor file-backed seam > commits reply session initialization despite non-identity metadata changes

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 59 skipped (60)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts -t "clears recovered Codex fallback metadata for Discord channel sessions on /new|clears stale runtime model cache fields on /new and /reset" --reporter=verbose

 ✓ |auto-reply-reply| src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts > ... > clears recovered Codex fallback metadata for Discord channel sessions on /new
 ✓ |auto-reply-reply| src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts > ... > clears stale runtime model cache fields on /new and /reset (#77322)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed | 122 skipped (124)
```

### CI note

The previous CI run failed three test shards:

1. `src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts` reset override clearing tests — **related**, fixed by switching from a full-row merge to snapshot-diff merge.
2. `test/scripts/render-maturity-docs.test.ts` — passes locally (see command above) and is unrelated to session logic.
3. `src/agents/agent-bundle-mcp-runtime.test.ts` — timed out waiting for a slow MCP initialize file; this code is unrelated to the session accessor change.
